mapper.select: SELECT region_id AS regionId, region_name AS regionName, province_name AS provinceName, district_name AS districtName FROM region WHERE province_name IS NOT NULL AND district_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY province_name, district_name, region_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO members ( region_id, email, password_hash, name, nickname, phone, birth_date, gender ) VALUES ( #{regionId}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{name}, #{nickname}, #{phone}, #{birthDate}, #{gender} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM email_verification WHERE verification_id = ( SELECT verification_id FROM email_verification WHERE email = #{email} ORDER BY verification_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND verified_at <= expires_at AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

SELECT member_id, password_hash, account_status, system_role FROM members WHERE email = #{email} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT m.member_id AS memberId, m.name, m.email, m.phone, m.nickname, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, m.birth_date, CURRENT_DATE()) AS age, m.gender, m.profile_img_url AS profileImageUrl, m.region_id AS regionId, r.region_name AS regionName, r.province_name AS provinceName, r.district_name AS districtName, (m.identity_verified_at IS NOT NULL) AS identityVerified, (m.region_verified_at IS NOT NULL) AS regionVerified, m.region_verified_at AS regionVerifiedAt FROM members m LEFT JOIN region r ON r.region_id = m.region_id WHERE m.member_id = #{memberId} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT i.interest_id AS interestId, i.interest_name AS interestName FROM member_interest mi INNER JOIN interest i ON mi.interest_id = i.interest_id WHERE mi.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY i.interest_id
SELECT member_id AS memberId, password_hash AS passwordHash, account_status AS accountStatus, system_role AS systemRole FROM members WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `groups` g INNER JOIN saving_group sg ON sg.group_id = g.group_id WHERE g.deleted_at IS NULL AND sg.status IN ('02', '03') AND ( g.member_id = #{memberId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM group_member gm WHERE gm.group_id = g.group_id AND gm.member_id = #{memberId} AND gm.membership_status = 'APPROVED' ) )
mapper.update: UPDATE members SET account_status = 'INACTIVE', deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND account_status != 'INACTIVE'
